messages:
Maya: Quick sync — product needs a concrete EU ship plan next month. Canaries, slices, fallback matrix. Who's free?
Arun: here. propose a "canary battery" — run multiple small canaries across slices (mobile, desktop, auth-heavy, long-context) to catch varied failure modes.
Priya: +1. also require automatic throttles for kv-cache hit regressions and a circuit-breaker on 5xx spikes. define p95 and error-rate gates.
Sam: AcmeFin wants licensed-region + IP allowlist. They'll need Dedicated/Private. For now, keep hosted but route Acme once contract signed.
Leo: Metrics gating = 3 signals: p95 latency, 5xx rate, and eval prompt-set regression (synthetic). All must pass to ramp.
Arun: initial slices: global-0.5%, eu-west-1%, vip-internal-0.2%, plus 1 shadow cohort for A/B scoring. Ramp: 0.5 -> 3 -> 10 -> 25 over 48h windows with checks.
Maya: exact gate thresholds?
Priya: propose: p95 < 1.4x baseline, 5xx < 0.2%, eval-quality delta < 1% on key prompts. if any fail, immediate auto-rollback + page.
Arun: feature-flag name: ff.ship.slate_v2. rollout config sketch:
```routes:
- slice: eu-west
  percent: 1
- slice: mobile
  percent: 0.5
rollout_checks:
- p95_delta: 1.4
- error_rate: 0.2%
- eval_delta: 1%
```
Sam: Stagger canaries by timezone to surface diurnal issues. Start eu-west 03:00 UTC, us-west 11:00 UTC, mobile slice +6h.
Maya: agree. need smoke checklist for on-call: top 5 endpoints, token-cost delta, billing watermark, model-quality sanity.
Priya: add kill-switch tag so on-call can set ff.ship.slate_v2=off and traffic routes immediately to fallback-model-id: redwood-base-1.
Leo: eval harness will run continuous A/B scoring. if quality regressed >0.5% for 30m, page eng-lead.
Arun: fallback battery: primary = quantized-variant, secondary = smaller model, tertiary = degraded UX (shorter context + soft fallback message). Document sequence in playbook.
Maya: data residency: EU logs/traces must stay in EU. add to launch criteria and infra checklist.
Sam: budget cap per slice to limit token churn from canaries. propose cap variable $CAP_PER_SLICE/day and auto-throttle when hit.
Priya: ops rules: autoscaler override if GPU mem or CPU > 85% for 10m. Automatic spillover to Dedicated pool if policy allows.
Arun: rollout API + CLI example to adjust slice percent / pause slice:
```bash
ri rollout update --flag ff.ship.slate_v2 --slice eu-west --percent 3
ri rollout pause --flag ff.ship.slate_v2 --slice mobile
```
Maya: owners: Solutions drafts customer comms. Maya + Arun own internal runbook. Priya owns on-call playbook.
Leo: schedule: canary start target ts 2034600000 — engineering verification by EOD Friday.
Priya: I'll produce circuit-breaker test plan (simulate 5xx and latency) and runbook steps for on-call.
Arun: dev note: prefix-cache warm for EU models before traffic. add a shadow-warm phase (0 traffic, full warm) for 2h.
Maya: decision: launch scope = hosted EU slice + routing policies + canary battery + auto-rollback. Dedicated onboarding for AcmeFin = follow-up EPIC.
Sam: ack. I'll draft customer-facing note and sync with sales on AcmeFin.
deploy-bot: deploy started for ff.ship.slate_v2 canary (eu-west, 0.5%) — build 2026.3.4
Arun: warm phase running now, will post counters after first 30m.
Maya: thanks all. next check-in in #product tomorrow 09:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
